verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a business account product, so automated multi-bank deposit sweeping for expanded FDIC coverage is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows opt-in passthrough FDIC insurance up to $250,000 through a single Program Bank. That is an adjacent feature: nothing documents sweeping deposits across multiple partner banks to raise coverage beyond that limit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have deposits automatically swept across partner banks to maximize FDIC insurance coverage
